reason: Our buyers already run supplier chasing through Epicor and our ERP partner, and I'd have to bolt on an outside tool that reads our PO exports and supplier emails. Early-stage product with no ERP integration means I'd be checking its output by hand, which eats the time it's supposed to save.
objection: AI will get a date wrong and we'll miss a shortage, and then I'm the one who answers to the plant manager for the missed work order.
would_change_my_mind: A free six-week test that catches real late or short supplier dates our team had already missed, with our ERP partner signing off on how the export is pulled.
